blocks.text: “Tawag ng Tanghalan” alum and social media personality Justin Taller received support from fans after he came out as part of the LGBTQIA+ community. The singer revealed this through a series of posts on his social media pages featuring his reunion with his former “girl crush” named Sam. “Dati ikaw lang yung gusto ko, pero ngayon parehas na tayo ng gusto,” he wrote in the caption. In one of the videos, the pair took on a playful TikTok dance trend. “Kinalaban mo ang sakadongvading,” he said, a play on the song’s lyrics.
